trap.label: bring vs take
trap.wrong: Bring this book to the teacher over there.
trap.right: Take this book to the teacher over there.
trap.why: Em português levar e trazer dependem do ponto de vista; o aluno usa bring sempre. Bring = trazer para cá; take = levar para lá.

mcq.q: Please ___ your book to class tomorrow (venha para cá).
Qual é o passado de bring?
Can you ___ me a glass of water?

fix.wrong: I bring my dog to the park every day.
fix.right: I take my dog to the park every day.

rewrite.prompt: Peça para trazer: “water / please / me / Bring”
Troque por take: “I bring my son to school.”
rewrite.answer: I take my son to school.
